title: Print the CV PDF with Browser Rendering from the published /cv page; never build it with pdf-lib or put it back in the build
body: `pnpm run build` is `astro build` and nothing else. The served PDF is printed at runtime by `functions/_handler.ts` (via `functions/cv.pdf.ts` / `functions/en/cv.pdf.ts`) with Cloudflare Browser Rendering over the PUBLISHED `/cv` / `/en/cv`. Two reasons: (1) the build runs anywhere, Pages included, with no Chromium (it used to start Playwright and had to build in Actions and upload `dist/`); (2) the PDF is not a build artifact, so the day data comes from an API instead of `content.es.json` the PDF is current with nobody regenerating a file. Only `/cv` has to be current. Rejected: building the PDF with `pdf-lib` or similar — that writes the layout twice (CSS for `/cv`, coordinates for the PDF) and the copies drift; `src/pages/cv.astro` is the single layout. `scripts/render-pdf.ts` / `pdf:local` only produce the pre-deploy gate's copy, not the deliverable.
not_derivable: The pdf-lib rejection and the 'PDF must not be a build artifact' rationale are not stated in code comments.

evidence.summary: Shared Browser Rendering implementation for both PDF routes.
Print options shared by the tested and the served PDF.
